settings.title: Description
settings.content: Island Escape features three sun-drenched scents drifting in a fresh summer breeze. Beach Skin’s creamy coconut and vanilla melt into Island Swim’s sparkling citrus and ocean mist, while Paradise Nectar blooms with luminous florals and ripe fruit. Layer them together for a wardrobe of summer scents that settles like sun on bare skin.

settings.title: In This Set
settings.content: Island Swim, Paradise Nectar, and Beach Skin travel size body mists.

settings.title: Notes
settings.content:
Island Swim: Bergamot Splash, Calamansi, Coconut, Ocean Mist, Blue Lavender, Plumeria, Sandalwood, Marine Amber, Skin Musk.

Paradise Nectar: Black Currant, Pink Pepper, Mandarin, Tuberose, Jasmine, Lotus Flower, Patchouli, Amber Woods, Cashmere Woods.

Beach Skin: Bergamot, Salted Tiare Flower, Pink Pepper, Coconut Milk, Lily of the Valley, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Musk.
